recipe.notes: This app has no migrations folder, so the database is set up with 'prisma db push'. I ran that against the empty database and it worked. The start command (node scripts/start.mjs) runs the same schema push again and then runs 'next start -p $PORT'. Run 'npm run build' first: it does 'prisma generate' and then 'next build'. I did not run the build, typecheck or tests, so the folder stays unchanged; only the database push was tried. No seed is needed and there are no starting accounts. To make the first account, go to /register and enter an email and password, then sign in. You are taken to /welcome, where you name the studio and give your name. After that: add clients, then invoices with line items. Invoices are in GBP, default to 20% tax and are numbered INV-0001, INV-0002 and so on for each studio. Status only moves forward: draft, then sent, then paid. Only a draft can be edited. 'Still owed' adds up the sent invoices. Any studio member can add a colleague on the Team page (name, email and a starting password); the colleague then signs in with that password. An email that already has an account is refused. Emails such as password reset are printed to the server console, not sent. The session cookie is marked Secure in production, so open the app at http://localhost:52747, not at a LAN IP over plain http. The unit tests need no database.
